description.zh: 用调用栈、汉诺塔和递归树说明递归：规模怎样缩小、每层做多少事决定总代价；以归并排序展示分而治之。计数来自页面内真实执行。
description.en: Explain recursion with the call stack, Towers of Hanoi and recursion trees: how the size shrinks and how much each level does set the total cost; merge sort shows divide and conquer. Counts come from code actually running on the page.

reason.zh: 汉诺塔每增加一个盘子，步数翻倍再加 1，总数是 2ⁿ−1，这是指数函数的一个具体例子；二分查找则对应对数。
reason.en: Each extra Hanoi disk doubles the moves and adds 1, giving 2ⁿ−1, a concrete exponential function, while binary search corresponds to the logarithm.

reason.zh: 二分查找每次把规模减半并只进入一个子问题，递归树是一条链；汉诺塔缩小 1 却分成两个子问题，所以代价量级完全不同。
reason.en: Binary search halves the size and enters just one subproblem, so its recursion tree is a chain; Hanoi shrinks by 1 but splits into two subproblems, so its cost is of a completely different order.

title.zh: 为什么有的递归瞬间完成，有的永远算不完？
title.en: Why do some recursions finish instantly and others never finish?
